basic_info.description: Unbelievable price for this stunning Luxurious condo at One Rincon Hill, where southwest-facing views fill the space with natural light and offer breathtaking panoramas of San Francisco's Twin Peaks, Oracle Park, and the dazzling cityscape. On 44th floor, residence #4405 is a 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom and features expansive floor-to-ceiling windows, elegant hardwood flooring, and a chef-inspired kitchen with granite countertops and premium Bosch and Sub-Zero appliances. Designed by the acclaimed architectural firm Solomon, Cordwell, Buenz and Associates, the building showcases timeless late-modernist elegance. Residents enjoy an array of upscale amenities, including exclusive access to The Harrison's Uncle Harry's Penthouse Lounge, a state-of-the-art fitness center, a sparkling pool, a sunlit sundeck, a relaxing spa, a welcoming hospitality room, and professional on-site management services. The home includes one car valet parking and additional storage space.
